Commentary.Commentary: A commanding performance from the Kiwis. They go 1-0 up. India will look to square things up as these two meet again on the 27th of this month at 7 am IST (1.30 am GMT). Do join us in advance for the build up. Till then, cheers.

The skipper of New Zealand, Kane Williamson says he felt it was a par total but he knew if they were a partnership, they can chase down anything. Credits the way Latham played and says it is one of the most special knocks he has seen. Adds one is always in the game here because of the dimensions and it was a good wicket but partnerships was key and it is then quite hard to defend. Adds the India spinners got some turn and he was surprised by it. Ends by saying he is happy to contribute and he just wanted to stay in with Latham.

Shikhar Dhawan, the skipper of India says it is a bit different to the other grounds and they did not bowl according to the plans. Mentions once they got a partnership they failed to make a breakthrough and they were a little too short. Adds Latham took the game away from them and that is where the momentum shifted completely. Admits he enjoys batting here and he is happy he scored a half ton here and he hopes to learn out of this. Ends by saying they need to improve their bowling and need the batters to play on the strength of their bowling.

Tom Latham is the Player of the Match. He says everything came off well, he was in pressure coming into this game but it paved off well. Reckons he was just trying to be in a good position and put the ball in the gaps. Shares that he is preparing well to get back in form. Admits Sundar was getting some turn but with the small ground, they capitalized and applauds the skipper's performance later. Says the stars are aligning and hopes to continue the same way.
...Presentation coming up...

Earlier in the day, after being inserted, the Indian openers got off to a really good start but then lost their way. Iyer though took them to a really good total with a cameo from Sundar but two outstanding innings from Latham and Williamson saw the Kiwis take a 1-0 lead in this series.

India's bowling was really good till the ball did not get soft. They hit the right lines and lengths, especially Umran Malik, Thakur and Sundar. However, later on, they failed to handle the pressure when the game was drifting away from them. There were a lot of poor deliveries and the Kiwi batters took full toll of it. Chahal and Arshdeep were disappointing and Thakur towards the end was really poor. India will be a tad disappointed to not have defended this after the position they were in.

The hosts were down and out when they lost three wickets for not a lot but then came the match-winning stand between Latham and Williamson. The two took their time, especially the latter but managed to find the fence whenever needed. They added over 200 with Latham scoring a magical 145 and Williamson ending up with 6 short of a ton. The two took the onus onto themselves to chase down a score which at one stage looked very far away.

What a chase that is from the Kiwis! It is yet again that man, the guy who loves batting against India, Tom Latham who has risen to the occasion. He received brilliant support from his skipper but it is his innings which won the game for them.
FOUR! The skipper hits the winning runs. A famous win for the Kiwis. How easy was that! Shorter and outside off. Williamson dabs it wide of third man for a boundary. NEW ZEALAND WIN BY 7 WICKETS.
FOUR! 2 runs needed now. Shorter and around off. Latham pulls it to deep mid-wicket for four runs.
A yorker, outside off. Latham fails to jam it out.
Length and on off. Williamson dabs it to third man for a single.
A slower length ball on middle. Latham pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Length ball, outside off. Latham pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Length and on middle. Kane tucks it to mid-wicket for a single. He is happy to give away the strike. He is batting on 89 and is happy with the teams' victory.
FOUR! Through the man! Tossed up, outside off. Latham sweeps it hard to deep mid-wicket. Umran Malik runs to his left but dives over the ball for a boundary. 14 off the over 11 needed now.
On middle. Blocked out.
FOUR! Too cheeky! Flighted, full and outside off. Latham waits, plays with the back of the bat and past the keeper to the third man fence. Too good.
FOUR! Too slow, too short and way outside off. Latham rocks back and pulls it to mid-wicket for a boundary. 200 of the partnership comes up.
Shorter and outside off, Kane slaps it to deep cover for a run.
Tossed up on off. Latham reverse hits it to deep point for a single.
Too full and on the pads, helped it down to fine leg for a single. 13 off it.
Full and on off. Kane steps across and tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, driven to mid off for a quick single.
SIX! Latham is making it look so easy. Short in length and on leg. Latham pulls it high behind square leg for a biggie.
Very full and outside off, Latham jams it out to backward point.
FOUR! Not a debut to remember for Singh! Pitched up, outside off. Latham leans and drives it beautifully through covers for four.
Flatter and on middle, turning away. Williamson looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but that was going down.
Full ball on middle. Latham goes inside out to mid off for one.
This is way outside off. Latham sweeps but back onto his pads.
Tossed up on off. Williamson flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full and outside off, swept behind square leg for a single.
Touch short and around off, this one holds. Williamson looks to pull but miscues it to long off for a single.
A single as this is guided down to third man.
FOUR! Angled into the pads, this is clipped down to fine leg for one.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Outside off, shorter, Latham slashes but misses.
SIX! Sails over the fence! Not sure if he intended it to go there. On middle, Latham looks to flick, this goes off the top edge and over the fine leg fence.
Short but down the leg side. Latham looks to pull but misses. No ball signaled.
On the shorter side, this is pulled but to mid-wicket.
On the pads, this is swept through square leg for another single.
On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On the pads. This is swept but once again to short fine leg.
On the pads, this is swept towards short fine leg.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
On the pads again, Kane works it past square leg and takes one.
Two more! On the pads, Williamson clips it through square leg for two.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Angled into the pads. This is clipped through square leg for one.
On off, this is defended.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
FOUR! Through the off side this time! This is full and outside off, Latham carves it away through point and the ball races away to the fence.
FOUR MORE! This is probably the over which turns the tide completely in the favor of the hosts! Another short one and on the body, this is pulled over short fine leg and into the fence.
FOUR! It is all going wrong for Thakur!15 from the first three balls he has bowled! This is short and on the body, it is pulled over short fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Latham is in a hurry to end the game here! This is short and on middle, it is pulled over mid-wicket for a boundary.
WIDE! Way too short! Down the leg side. Wided.
SIX! Over the fence! Not sure if short is the way to go against Latham! It is on the body, Latham pulls it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
A single to end then! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
A single now! On the pads, this is worked towards short fine leg for one.
Three more! A full toss on the pads, this is worked through wide long on. Thakur runs to his left and keeps it down to three.
Another dot! Goes full again and on the pads, Latham can't beat mid-wicket.
A low full toss on off, tails back in a little. Latham works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! That is a fortunate boundary! Latham won't care though! A corker of a yorker on middle. Latham tries to get his bat down, it goes off the inside edge and down to the fine leg fence.
A good comeback from Sundar after going for a boundary on the first ball. A good spell from him too. On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket. 100 needed in the last 12 overs.
Shorter and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Another one! On the pad, this is worked through square leg for one more. 100 needed now.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Good sensible batting! On middle, this lands and turns away. Latham looks to work it on the leg side but it goes off the leading edge towards short third man for one.
FOUR! A boundary to begin the over! Sundar under huge pressure now! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence. This stand is running away with the game now.
A single to end then! On middle, fuller, this is hit down to long on for one. A productive over for the Kiwis. 200 is also up for them!
Another dot! On off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
WIDE! Down the leg side this time. Wided.
SIX! BANG! The risk is taken and it comes off! A little too short from Arshdeep Singh and he pays for it! This is pulled well over the square leg fence for a biggie.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Angled into the pads, Kane Williamson works it through mid-wicket and takes one.
THree dots in a row now! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On the shorter side again, this is yet again pushed to cover.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
WIDE! Well wide outside off. Wided.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one. The 100-run stand is up. Still a long way to go.

DROPPED! Tough chance but should have been taken! Dhawan is the culprit! On middle, this one turns back in. Williamson flicks it uppishly towards mid-wicket. Dhawan dives forward and gets two hands to it but spills it. How costly will this prove?
FOUR! He fails to do so and that releases the pressure that was building! On the pads, this is clipped over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence. 120 needed in the last 15 overs then.
Yet another very good delivery! A yorker outside off, Latham looks to jam it out but misses. Can he end the over well now?
Angled into the pads. Williamson looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Goes short again and on the body, Latham looks to pull but misses. It hits the body and rolls on the leg side for one. No signal by the umpire sso there might be an inside edge.
Quick! Shorter and on middle, Latham looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Dots will build pressure. India need more.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked towards mid on for one.
Tidy over then from Sundar! On the pads, this is clipped towards short fine leg for one.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one. Fifty for Latham. Top knock. Came in under a pressure situation and has played brilliantly. Needs to go on.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards deep mid-wicket for one.
A dot to end but that is a top over for the Kiwis! 132 needed in 102. On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Two more! Latham is playing Umran really well! On the pads, this is clipped through mid-wicket for two.
A good comeback! A yorker outside off. Latham fails to jam it out.
SIX! Over the fence! This is short and asking to be hit! Latham helps it on its way and it sails over the fine leg fence. 10 from two balls and now the pressure is on Malik.
FOUR! A little bit of width on offer and Latham cashes in! This is slightly short and outside off. Latham waits and guides it past point for a boundary.
Bangs it short, this hurries onto Latham, he mistimes it to mid-wicket.
A dot to end! Flatter and on middle, Kane Williamson guides it to point.
Latham looks to reverse sweep again, this is fired on the pads. Latham misses, it hits the pad and goes towards short fine leg for one. Leg bye again.
Off the outer half and three! Outside off, Kane Williamson steps out and looks to go over covers, it goes off the outer half towards third man for three.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Two is the call and two is what they get! On the pads, this is clipped through square leg for a couple.

A LOUD APPEAL BUT TURNED DOWN! Dhawan signals for the review. It is for an LBW. The pitching could be an issue. NOT OUT! It has pitched outside leg and India lose a review! On the pads. Latham looks to sweep but misses. It hits the pad. A loud appeal but the umpire shakes his head. A leg bye in the end as it rolls towards square leg.
FOUR! Gets the boundary which releases the pressure! This is short and on middle, Williamson pulls it over mid-wicket and bags a boundary. The last ball spoils the over somewhat.
Bangs this short, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Just the one! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket for one.
On off, defended.
Williamson steps out, the length is shortened, he looks to guide it to point but is hit on the glove.
On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Full and on middle. Kane Williamson pushes it to long off for a single. These two motoring along nicely. The stand moves past 60. New Zealand need 157 runs now.
Too full and on off. Latham reverse sweep to point for a single.
Shorter and on middle. Latham pulls it to deep square leg. A bit fumble from Suryakumar Yadav allows batters for two runs.
Flatter, outside off, turning away. Williamson forces it to deep cover for a single.
On middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Shorter and outside off. Williamson punches it through covers for a single.
Pitched up, outside off. Driven nicely but finds cover.
On a length and outside off. Latham mistimes his punch to point.
Outside off, guided to backward point.
FOUR! Just over! Short of a length and outside off. Latham cuts but it goes off the outside edge and over the leaping first slip fielder for a boundary.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
FOUR! Captain finding his form back! Good knock so far! Fifty for him! Has held one end! Short and on middle. Williamson pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
On middle, punched to cover.

This one spins back in, outside off. Latham comes forward to negotiate.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Too full and around off. Latham reverse hits it through backward point, in the gap for a boundary.

On middle, length and it is flicked through square leg for one.
A length ball, outside off, Latham punches it through covers for a single.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Short in length and on middle. Latham bunts it to deep square leg for a single.
A length and on middle. Latham drills it to mid on.
Length and outside off. Latham guides it to point.
Tossed up, outside off, eased to long on for a single.
On middle, kept out.
On middle, nudged to square leg for one.
SIX! Too slow from Sundar, outside off. Williamson uses his feet as he steps across and launches it over long on for a biggie.
Tossed up on middle, Williamson tucks it to square leg.
Shorter and outside off. Latham slaps it to deep point for a single.
This is full and outside off. Williamson dabs it fine to third man. Washington Sundar runs to his left, slides and does well to save a couple.
TAP AND RUN! Outside off, dropped to mid off for a single.
On a length and on off. Blocked out.
Length and on middle, flicked to square leg for a single.
Extra bounce this time, short and on middle. Williamson mistimes his nudge on the hips.
Full ball on middle, bunted to mid-wicket.

Tossed up, outside off. Latham leans and keeps it out.

Fuller ball, outside off, turning away. Latham looks to push but gets an outside edge to short third man.
Flatter and outside off, punched to cover.
Tossed up on middle, turn and bounce. Williamson flicks on the up and well over mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length and outside off. Latham slashes and misses.
A length ball, outside off and swings away. Latham looks to defend but misses.
On middle, blocked out.
FOUR! Just like before! This time Latham cuts it fine to third man for a boundary. Second of the over.
Wide! Bouncer on middle. Latham sits and a wide is given.
FOUR! Short and outside off. Latham cuts it hard and to third man where Shardul Thakur lets it go sloppily for a boundary.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Angling on the pads, clipped to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off. Blocked out.
Flatter and outside off. Latham plays it late to first slip.
Outside off, Tom keeps it out.
This one holds on the deck and spins away. Latham looks to flick but gets an outside edge past first slip and to third man for a couple. Good stop by Chahal.
Shorter and outside off, Williamson punches it through covers for a single.

On middle, blocked out.

EDGY FOUR! That is a beauty, an absolute beauty! This is on a length and around off, it lands and moves away. Williamson is squared up as he tries to defend, it goes off the outside edge and down to the third man fence. No slip in place and it races away to the fence.
Williamson steps out and pushes it down to long on for one.
Slower through the air and on middle, defended.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On middle, kept out.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to cover.
Back of a length and on off, Mitchell plays it towards point.
On the fuller side, this is pushed to mid off.
Back of a length and on off, DM pushes it to covers.

Back of a length and on off, Williamson guides it to point.
Angled into the pads, Williamson works it to mid-wicket.
On the stumps, kept out. 7 from Chahal's second then.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
SIX! That is a flat biggie, that has gone so very flat. Short boundaries and he just about clears it. On middle, Mitchell comes down the track and slams it ovre the long on fence for a biggie.
Tossed up on middle, defended.

On middle, this is worked to the left of mid-wicket for one.

Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Umran Malik

Commentary.Commentary: A single to end an 11-run over! On the pads, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On the shorter side, Williamson hits it down to long on for one.

FOUR! Two in a row for Williamson! 9 from the first three balls of this over and will this be the momentum shifting over? This is short again and on middle, it is pulled over mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! That is a poor delivery and that will release a little bit of pressure! Shorter and on off, this is pulled over mid-wicket for a welcome boundary.
Slightly shorter, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.

On off, defended.
Again the reverse sweep, this time a single as the fielder at backward point does not stop it cleanly.
Plays the reverse sweep but straight to the man at point.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut towards point for one.
Nicely timed! Length and on off, Williamson strokes it on the up through mid off. The fielder hares after it, pushes it back and keeps it down to three.
Tip and run! Another short one and on off, Conway plays it towards point and takes one.
Back of a length and on off, defended.
Another one outside off, not played at.
Length and outside off, left alone.

Flatter and on middle, defended.
Lands safe! On middle, Williamson looks to flick, it goes off the top edge over short mid-wicket for one.

Outside off, Williamson pushes it through covers for one.
Plays the paddle scoop, towards short fine leg for one.
On middle, defended.
A single to end a tidy first from Malik! Angled into the pads, this is worked towards fine leg for one.
Leadig edge but one! On middle, this lands and moves away. Williamson looks to work it on the leg side but this goes off the leading edge towards third man for one.
Another single! Fuller and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Attacks the stumps again, Kane pushes it to covers.
Angled into middle, Williamson works it to mid-wicket.
Swing and a miss! Full ball, outside off, slanting across. Conway skips down to go big but only connects thin air around.
Thakur comes back to target the stumps. This is around off. Conway keeps it out.
FOUR! That is a beautiful shot! On a length and outside off. Conway dances down the track and punches it over covers for a boundary. Much needed. Welcome one.
Angles across a length ball to Conway who lets it go.
Full and outside off. Williamson drives it to cover where Suryakumar Yadav dives to his left and gets a big hand on it. One.
Full ball, outside off, swinging away. Williamson guides it to short third man.
A single to end the over as this is hit to long on.
Tossed up on off, turning in. Williamson clips it late to square leg.
Williamson gets an outside edge this time straight to short third man.
Floated, full and outside off. Williamson dabs it to backward point.
Keeps it way outside off. Williamson knocks it to cover.
Flatter and outside off. Conway punches it to mid off for a run.
Outside off again. Williamson lets it through to the keeper.
Full ball, outside off, left alone.
BEAUTY! Very full and outside off, swings away late. Williamson looks to drive but misses.
Kane Williamson walks in.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Yuzvendra Chahal will be the most relieved man! It didn't cost much! Shardul Thakur gets the reward for good bowling. Allen stays back and tries to push but gets a faint edge to the keeper, Pant who makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on middle. Blocked out.

Dropped by Chahal! Should have been taken at this stage! On a length and on middle. Allen flicks it straight to mid-wicket. It came at a good height to Chahal who tries to reverse cup but fails to hold on. Will this cost India?

Fuller, angling down leg. Conway looks to clip but gets a leading edge to point.

Tossed up on middle. Conway prods and blocks it out.
On middle, flat. Allen tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
